physical_blocks.exact_text:
Note: Prior diseases are coded using MedDRA(Version 22.1).
Prior diseases are these diseases with an end date prior to the date of first chemotherapy. Concomitant diseases are these diseases starting on or after the date of first dose of
chemotherapy, or diseases starting prior to the date of first dose of chemotherapy but continuing after the date of first dose of chemotherapy.
